name: Bounded terminal disposition
conditions: Work completes or is explicitly rejected or cancelled with truthful outcome and released owned resources
feedback: None required and no attraction claimed
entry: Finite work drains or a valid terminal decision is applied
exit: New work or a new perturbation
survives: Outcome evidence and remaining capacity
lost: The completed opportunity may have expired even when disposition is correct
falsifier: An allegedly terminal operation still holds a slot or can dispatch again
evidence: Qualitative reference endpoint rather than a measured steady state

name: Unobserved outage
conditions: Compute or the independent path to an observer is unavailable
feedback: No autonomous feedback follows from power or network absence alone
entry: Host power loss or common dependency failure or observer failure
exit: Power and a functioning observation path return or another observer supplies evidence
survives: Previously durable local records if media survive and possibly independent copies
lost: Current execution and remote knowledge of its condition are unavailable rather than necessarily destroyed
falsifier: A fresh independent observation reaches a reachable responder during the claimed total blindness
evidence: Qualitative conditional failure-domain reasoning with no deployment topology inspected

name: Green without useful service
conditions: A liveness display is decoupled from commits or useful work or accepts stale or incomplete evidence
feedback: A fixed bad probe maintains the report but is not itself autonomous feedback. If green suppresses repair it can prolong the underlying fault
entry: Independent health thread or cache or aggregate masks a failed path
exit: An observation of the failing path changes the verdict or underlying service recovers
survives: Some reads or a reporting process and historic samples
lost: Truthful current service health and detection time
falsifier: Green requires a fresh successful operation through the failed path and expires without it
evidence: Qualitative. Read/write separation exists in source but no deployed health protocol was established

name: Alert exists but no human receives it
conditions: Detection or a send acknowledgement exists but the only responder has no accessible notification
feedback: No feedback is necessary. Delivery acceptance is not human receipt
entry: Spam filtering or unreachable operator or notification account lock
exit: A responder receives independent evidence or the original message and acts
survives: Detector evidence if retained and any independent recovery copies
lost: Time to human awareness and possibly action deadline
falsifier: A recorded acknowledgement by an authorized reachable human predates the alleged silent interval
evidence: Qualitative distinction among detection transport acceptance receipt and action

name: Administrative silence
conditions: An enabled suppression interval or mute persists with no functioning expiry
feedback: The stored policy continues to suppress signals. Duration alone does not establish an attractor
entry: Maintenance suppression outlives intended hour
exit: Suppression expires in the actual clock model or is explicitly lifted
survives: Work and raw evidence may continue
lost: Alert eligibility despite incidents
falsifier: Advancing the relevant clock automatically ends suppression at the original intended expiry
evidence: Qualitative policy semantics unspecified

name: Recovery evidence missing but not proven lost
conditions: Recovery-relevant identity liveness or key knowledge is unavailable and has not been proven permanently lost
feedback: No restoring feedback shown. Conservative session refusal retains ownership until evidence arrives
entry: Observation lost or restore makes old runtime claims untrustworthy or a recoverable key path has not been found
exit: Correlated authoritative observation or confirmed termination or discovery of an authorized decryption path or explicit human disposition
survives: Existing durable evidence and ciphertext where intact plus lease exclusion for ambiguous sessions
lost: Recovery progress and knowledge of actual condition plus capacity held by unresolved sessions
falsifier: The required evidence is already available and authoritative yet the claimed information-only wait persists
evidence: Source supports only the session lease and evidence-gate branch. Key discovery and full observer behavior are qualitative

name: Explicit authorization or freshness hold
conditions: Work is blocked pending human permission or a decision whether old intent remains valid
feedback: No autonomous feedback. A missing approver is not convergence
entry: Permission required or stale work intentionally withheld
exit: Fresh authorized decision cancels or allows bounded work
survives: Intent and the fact permission is absent
lost: Elapsed business time and perhaps usefulness of the task
falsifier: Work executes without the required decision or expiry is automatically terminal under the actual policy
evidence: Source supports blocked tasks and explicit resume. General stale-intent validation is only a conditional policy branch

name: Readable store unable to advance
conditions: Existing pages remain readable but durable writes fail
feedback: No self-sustaining loop follows from full or failed media. Retry load can separately enter OB11
entry: Commit refusal while old reads still answer
exit: Space or functioning durable storage becomes available and pending outcomes are reconciled
survives: Previously committed records if intact
lost: New durable mutations and honest success acknowledgements
falsifier: A new acknowledged mutation survives reopening and power-loss-equivalent storage semantics under the same fault
evidence: Source separates reads from BEGIN IMMEDIATE writes and propagates commit errors. Disk faults not exercised

name: Business deadline missed
conditions: Queue time or serial work or connection setup exceeds the original business deadline
feedback: None. A missed historical deadline is irreversible but does not imply future failure
entry: Time budget exhausted even if each inner call meets its local timeout
exit: No exit for the past deadline. Future work may meet deadlines under different conditions
survives: Possible eventual result and timing evidence
lost: The original timeliness promise
falsifier: Actual end-to-end elapsed time including queue and connection setup is within the original deadline
evidence: Qualitative arithmetic with explicit serial versus parallel assumptions

name: Slots consumed by nonterminating work
conditions: Requests that never finish retain finite slots and have no effective reclamation
feedback: Under continuing arrivals each rare hang reduces service capacity. With arrivals stopped the occupied slots persist but no autonomous growth follows
entry: At least one unreclaimable hang in a finite pool
exit: Proven termination or effective reclamation or replacement of the pool
survives: Durable requests and any unoccupied isolated pools
lost: Usable slots progressively rather than necessarily immediately
falsifier: Every stalled request releases its slot within a measured finite bound
evidence: Qualitative finite-pool model. No production arrival distribution or lifetime bound measured

name: Retry load sustains overload
conditions: Enough retry-producing work remains and overload lowers successful service below offered plus retry load
feedback: Slow service causes timeouts and retries which consume more service and produce more failures. Persistence after initial fault requires ongoing retries or arrivals
entry: A burst or dependency slowdown crosses capacity threshold
exit: Retry work ceases or remaining load falls below sustainable capacity long enough to drain
survives: Some durable intent and work on genuinely isolated capacity
lost: Throughput latency and possibly provider budget
falsifier: Remove the initial fault and freeze new external arrivals. Backlog drains despite retry policy rather than settling into overload
evidence: Qualitative feedback hypothesis not an observed Factory attractor. ADR restart budgets constrain only their own restart loop

name: Synchronized finite surge
conditions: A finite population wakes or retries together and offered work temporarily exceeds service
feedback: The initial synchronization alone supplies no continuing feedback. Retries may branch to OB11
entry: Power or provider restoration or identical retry timer expiry
exit: Finite demand drains or is truthfully rejected with residual capacity
survives: Queued intent and eventual service if capacity and deadlines suffice
lost: Short-term latency or perishable business opportunities
falsifier: Demand remains elevated without new arrivals or internally generated retries after the original cohort is served
evidence: Qualitative finite-burst interpretation

name: Head-of-line obstruction
conditions: A shared queue or all-of barrier cannot bypass one large slow or missing item
feedback: No loop is needed. Persistence depends on obstruction duration and queue discipline
entry: Huge export or never-returning child occupies required service position
exit: Blocking item ends or the actual semantics permit bypass or bounded failure
survives: Pending small requests and partial results if retained
lost: Independent progress and responsiveness on the shared path
falsifier: Small requests progress independently while the named blocker remains
evidence: Qualitative queue/barrier mechanism not demonstrated in a running plugin host

name: Normal work starved by priority demand
conditions: Priority service is strict and high-priority offered load consumes all available capacity
feedback: Continued emergency arrivals maintain starvation. Stop those arrivals and normal work can drain
entry: Repeated emergency tasks arrive before normal queue gets service
exit: Priority demand drops below capacity or actual scheduling grants normal service
survives: Emergency throughput and queued normal intent
lost: Normal task latency and old business deadlines
falsifier: Normal work receives a positive service share despite indefinitely backlogged emergency work
evidence: Qualitative scheduler assumptions. No scheduler implementation inspected

name: Fast answer with incomplete or biased meaning
conditions: Sampling excludes unfinished work or a result labels a partial set complete
feedback: Selection continues to hide failures while policy is unchanged. No intrinsic feedback established
entry: Completed-only dashboard or closed-loop test or early aggregator answer
exit: Recompute the full denominator or expose partialness or obtain missing required results
survives: Measured completed samples and partial valid results
lost: Validity of the advertised whole-system or completeness claim
falsifier: The claim explicitly concerns only the sampled subset or the omitted result is not required by the real contract
evidence: Qualitative. Source task list includes every status so completed-only filtering is not established there

name: External effect unresolved
conditions: A dispatch may have crossed the external acceptance boundary but its result cannot yet be established
feedback: No feedback follows from unknown outcome. Repeating on uncertainty can branch to OB11 or OB17
entry: Lost reply or cancellation race or post-commit power loss
exit: Durable participant evidence resolves the operation or a human records an explicit limited disposition
survives: Local intent and attempt evidence where durable
lost: Knowledge whether the external effect happened and safe automatic retry eligibility
falsifier: The retained participant ledger proves accepted or definitively not accepted for the same durable identity
evidence: Source delivery journals before manual writer and refuses unauthorized repeats. General plugin reconciliation is an ADR promise

name: Unwanted irreversible effect occurred
conditions: A duplicate stale or unauthorized action crosses an irreversible external acceptance point
feedback: None is required. Compensation may mitigate consequences but cannot erase historical delivery
entry: Speculation or stale replay or late cancellation after acceptance
exit: No exit for the past action. Ongoing dispatch can cease and consequences can be mitigated separately
survives: Evidence and remaining correctly authorized work if not compromised
lost: Original no-duplicate no-send or correct-recipient property
falsifier: Participant evidence shows the operation was rejected before acceptance or genuinely reversible with no irreversible disclosure
evidence: Qualitative external semantics with irreversibility explicitly stipulated. Not an observed incident

name: Child continues beyond parent lifecycle
conditions: A descendant remains runnable and retains write or external credentials after parent timeout or exit
feedback: No loop is required and the stated two-day lifetime is finite. Self-restart would be an extra assumption
entry: Timeout kills or abandons parent without terminating descendants
exit: Descendants end or lose effective authority and all effects are reconciled
survives: Descendant execution and possibly its own output
lost: Truth of parent-finished-means-no-more-effects and workspace exclusivity if reused
falsifier: No descendant can write or invoke the participant after the parent boundary
evidence: Qualitative process-tree hypothesis. Source session stop assumes caller already confirmed process unusable

name: Two sources share one observation identity
conditions: Original and restored clone use the same logical heartbeat identity and observer cannot distinguish epochs
feedback: Competing arrivals overwrite or interleave evidence under one key. Continued ambiguity requires both sources or cached old data
entry: Clone starts with copied identity
exit: Evidence distinguishes source incarnation or one source is conclusively retired
survives: Messages and possibly both functioning instances
lost: Attribution of freshness health and ownership to the intended instance
falsifier: Observer consistently identifies both incarnations and never lets clone health certify the original
evidence: Qualitative monitor identity semantics unspecified. Session recovery identity is a different boundary

name: Trusted access cannot be established
conditions: Only authentication or key path rejects legitimate recovery traffic
feedback: Fail-closed policy holds access while identity dependency or incompatible key state persists. Not autonomous attraction
entry: IdP locked or rotation crosses partition
exit: A trusted credential path becomes usable without accepting forged authority
survives: Access denial and possibly local data
lost: Authorized recovery access or authenticated heartbeat delivery
falsifier: Authorized offline recovery succeeds while the sole IdP remains unavailable or overlap keys still validate
evidence: Qualitative. ADR safe mode is not an authorization bypass

name: Confidentiality already lost
conditions: An unauthorized party obtains sensitive plaintext or inferable sensitive content
feedback: No feedback needed. Copying makes past disclosure non-retractable
entry: Late data misrouting or exfiltration or later decryption of captured exports
exit: No exit for disclosed facts. Future access may be revoked
survives: Non-disclosed material and evidence if independent
lost: Secrecy of the disclosed information
falsifier: The adversary never acquired decryptable content or the alleged inference is no better than its stated baseline
evidence: Qualitative security outcome conditioned on actual access not merely suspicious text or a valid signature

name: Compromised controller reproduces trust
conditions: Attacker-controlled trusted code can persist and modify updates or the evidence used to approve recovery
feedback: Compromised updater reinstalls compromised code and compromised observer certifies it. Requires these powers and recurring recovery/update actions
entry: Trusted supply-chain payload gains execution on Factory and possibly monitor
exit: Independent trustworthy execution and evidence replace attacker-controlled persistence paths
survives: Only evidence and capabilities outside the compromised trust domain are independently credible
lost: Integrity of in-domain control and telemetry
falsifier: A clean restart from an independent pinned source remains clean despite the attacker retaining the alleged persistence path
evidence: Qualitative adversarial feedback hypothesis. Signed identity alone does not prove benign behavior

name: Restore cannot fit or finish in time
conditions: Recovery requires more simultaneous space or more time than available
feedback: No intrinsic loop. Repeated full-copy retries can consume additional space only under an extra retention policy
entry: Restore/replay starts against insufficient capacity or stated RTO
exit: Sufficient peak resources or different available recovery input permits completion
survives: Canonical bytes if copies are retained and readable
lost: Recovery-time promise and current service availability
falsifier: Measured peak footprint fits and full restore finishes within the stated RTO using the same inputs
evidence: Source backup creates another VACUUM INTO copy and refuses overwrite. Event replay performance is design-level not implemented evidence here

name: Encrypted history irrecoverable
conditions: Ciphertext remains but every feasible decryption path is permanently unavailable
feedback: None. Absence of a currently found key alone is only an information wait
entry: Last key or reconstruction knowledge is lost
exit: No feasible exit under assumptions. Discovery of escrow or future cryptanalysis changes those assumptions
survives: Ciphertext and non-secret metadata
lost: Authorized recovery of protected content
falsifier: Any independently recoverable key or working reconstruction path decrypts the vault
evidence: Qualitative with permanent key absence explicitly conditional and future cryptanalysis not excluded

name: Boundary rejects invalid work locally
conditions: Actual enforced size capability freshness or approval validation fails before unsafe acceptance
feedback: No feedback. Repeated violations stay isolated only if total costs and buffers are bounded
entry: Oversized request or unauthorized action reaches an enforcing boundary
exit: Correct authorized bounded request or explicit trusted release from quarantine
survives: Unaffected work and evidence of refusal when the refusal can be recorded
lost: The rejected request's progress but not necessarily its external opportunity
falsifier: Rejected input consumes unbounded resources or performs the prohibited effect before refusal
evidence: ADR frame and capability bounds are promises. Source delegation checks only its stated kinship and chain boundary

name: Cold-path capacity deficit
conditions: Connections caches or models are absent and first use costs more than warm service
feedback: Warmup can remove the deficit. Eviction or timeout restarts can create OB11 but are extra feedback assumptions
entry: Restart or cache miss or first network call
exit: Finite warming finishes with enough capacity or work expires
survives: Underlying service and durable intent
lost: First-call latency and optionally deadlines
falsifier: Latency remains at cold values after measured successful warming with no eviction or renewed failures
evidence: Qualitative distinction between cold transient and retry-maintained overload

name: Observation or message state exhausts resources
conditions: Labels inline frames compiled contexts or subscriber queues exceed available capacity or accumulate faster than retirement
feedback: Accumulation may continue with token/subscriber input. A restart/replay loop needs separate evidence
entry: High-cardinality metrics or slow consumers or oversized payload allocation
exit: Input stops and resources can be reclaimed or bounded isolated rejection occurs
survives: Core work only if resource pools are genuinely isolated
lost: Observation availability and possibly shared kernel memory or latency
falsifier: Total retained bytes stay bounded while adversarial labels or subscribers continue
evidence: ADR negotiates frame limits and subscriber backpressure but total cross-subscriber bounds are not demonstrated

name: Evidence needed for correlation erased
conditions: The only operation identity association or tombstone is deleted and no lawful independent mapping remains
feedback: None. Subsequent retries expose the loss rather than create it
entry: Retention expiry or legal deletion removes the last association
exit: No reconstruction under assumptions. New independent evidence would refute uniqueness of the lost copy
survives: Remaining unlinked records and privacy benefits of legitimate deletion
lost: Local ability to classify a late result or deduplicate using the erased identity
falsifier: Participant ledger or another lawfully retained stable mapping resolves the late item
evidence: Qualitative. ADR requires durable idempotency/content metadata but no retention horizon was established

name: Stop acknowledged without durable stop evidence
conditions: An acknowledgement is emitted despite failed durable stop recording
feedback: No intrinsic loop. A restart may resurrect dispatch from the old state if it trusts that state
entry: Full disk and premature success response
exit: Reconcile actual process state with durable intent once writes work or prove a separate stop authority persisted
survives: Old records and possibly an actually stopped process
lost: Trust in success acknowledgement and restart suppression
falsifier: Commit failure is returned as an error and no success is emitted or independent durable stop authority prevents resumed work
evidence: Counterfactual protocol failure. Inspected library stop/cancel return commit errors before success

name: Finite historical backlog
conditions: Old queued work or schedule occurrences are finite but numerous and business validity is not implied by durability
feedback: No autonomous multiplication assumed. Draining is possible if no new work exceeds capacity
entry: Long suspension ends and catch-up materializes old intent
exit: Finite valid backlog drains or receives explicit expired/skipped disposition. Relevance may require OB07
survives: Historical intent and occurrence evidence where stored
lost: Immediate capacity and old business deadlines
falsifier: Occurrence creation continues without bound after the fixed historical horizon is exhausted
evidence: Qualitative scheduler policy unknown. Source restore preserves never-attempted queued work without a freshness decision

name: Thermally limited service
conditions: Sustained load generates enough heat to reduce CPU service rate and cooling has finite response
feedback: Heat causes throttling and cooling may restore speed. Ongoing load sustains the reduced rate or thermal cycle. Retry amplification is separately OB11
entry: Long high utilization crosses thermal threshold
exit: Load drops or heat removal supports demanded service
survives: Slower compute and durable work
lost: Warm benchmark capacity and timing headroom
falsifier: At fixed offered load measured frequency and temperature do not correlate with the asserted service-rate reduction
evidence: Qualitative physical feedback. No device measurements or thermal thresholds collected

name: Concurrent writers after unsupported lease release
conditions: Old worker is still capable of writes when a replacement acquires the workspace
feedback: Two live writers maintain conflict while both run. TTL alone gives no evidence the first stopped
entry: Ambiguous lease expires by policy and replacement starts before old worker is fenced
exit: Old authority ends and conflicting effects are reconciled
survives: Possibly both processes and each one's output
lost: Single-writer workspace assumption and confidence in merged state
falsifier: Old process cannot write after lease release even while its OS process stays alive
evidence: Counterfactual TTL branch. Source keeps disconnected leases and stop has a caller-owned death precondition

name: Wrong authority accepted for an action
conditions: Authenticated identity does not bind the actual scope credential recipient immutable input or approval provenance
feedback: No intrinsic feedback. Successful abuse can lead to OB22 only if it also grants persistence
entry: Cross-scope credential lookup or mutable recipient or imported/logged approval is trusted
exit: Real binding validation rejects before acceptance or trusted review stops further actions
survives: Evidence of the authenticated caller may remain useful but is not proof of authorization
lost: Correct attribution authorization and potentially scope separation
falsifier: The exact action scope recipient version and principal are checked against independently trusted approval before dispatch
evidence: Qualitative threat branch. ADR trusted context is a design promise and prompt formatting is not security enforcement

name: Alarm fatigue reinforces silence
conditions: Repeated non-actionable alerts consume finite human attention and responders mute or ignore the detector
feedback: Noise causes dismissal which leaves the bad alert criterion uncorrected and produces more noise and dismissal. Requires this human response rather than assuming it
entry: Legitimately blocked workload triggers persistent progress alarms
exit: Responder separates expected holds from fault evidence or attention recovers and the false-alert source ends
survives: Task correctness and raw detector events if retained
lost: Effective response to later real incidents
falsifier: Responders keep acknowledging actionable alerts promptly despite the unchanged false-alert stream
evidence: Qualitative behavioral hypothesis not inferred from noisy alerts alone

name: Control path starved by data work
conditions: Cancel or stop shares a congested execution pool or serialized data channel with bulk operations
feedback: No feedback necessary. Continued data input can maintain starvation and retries can add OB11
entry: Large stdout backlog or saturated plugin invocation pool delays stop
exit: Data queue drains or actual independent bounded control service becomes available
survives: Already committed intent and possibly ongoing workers
lost: Timely cancellation or shutdown rather than necessarily eventual control delivery
falsifier: Stop or cancel takes effect within its bound while the same data queue remains saturated
evidence: Qualitative channel topology. ADR framed bidirectional stdio and shutdown deadlines do not establish preemptive control scheduling

name: Recursive fan-out expands demand
conditions: Each executed child creates on average more than one admitted child with no effective depth or total budget stopping the expansion
feedback: Work generates more work which generates more work. Finite legal scope chains bound depth but can still permit a very large finite tree
entry: A viral parent begins branching
exit: Branching falls below replacement or finite depth/budget is reached or admissions stop
survives: Task lineage where durably recorded
lost: Capacity cost visibility and possibly business budget
falsifier: Total admitted descendants remain bounded by a small enforced tree budget despite continued child execution
evidence: Qualitative growth. Source forbids scope revisits in one delegation chain but does not make branching factor one
